rows.label: At least 30 credits of NES-listed coursework toward the major
rows.note: Deliberately narrow: counts NES-listed courses below graduate level, leaving out honors essays and independent studies (the page caps those). Other-subject language courses, petitioned courses and outside credit may also count but are not visible here. Do not count NES language courses used for your language requirement.

rows.label: Core course: Theory and Method in Near Eastern Studies
rows.note: Offered each spring; it cannot be used for the temporal breadth requirement.

rows.label: Confirm your Middle Eastern language requirement (two years of one language, or one year each of two)
rows.note: Modern languages end at the fourth-semester course (Arabic, Hebrew, Persian or Turkish), placement can shorten the path, and ancient languages are allowed, so the board cannot check this.

rows.label: Confirm one course from each of three periods: before 600 CE, 600 to 1800 CE, and 1800 CE to the present
rows.note: The page gives no list assigning courses to periods; check with your advisor. The core course cannot be one of the three.

rows.label: Confirm every major course is letter-graded with B- or better
Confirm no course is used for two major requirements
rows.note: Language courses used for the language requirement do not also count as electives.

rows.label: Confirm limits: at most two independent studies, two petitioned non-NES Cornell courses, and 12 approved outside credits
rows.note: Independent-study courses are not identifiable from the page, so the credit row does not cap them.
